mentions.description: A service that lets any website add an AI chatbot/agent with minimal integration effort. Built as a learning project for LLMs and AI, including keeping things safe and preventing prompt injection. Well suited to project documentation and developer docs.

I am working on Entangle, https://entangle.cloud something for me to learn and play with LLMs and AI.

It is not ground breaking but let your website to have an AI chat bot / agent with minimal integration effort.

mentions.name: Entangle
mentions.description: Entangle is a service for adding an AI-powered chatbot and search to a website. It targets the European market with options to self-host the content and LLM models on customers' own servers (with technical support for setup), or to use provider-hosted servers for the content and models.
mentions.audience: European businesses and website owners looking to add an AI chatbot, including those who want to self-host content or models on their own servers
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on Entangle https://entangle.cloud a way to add AI powered chatbot to a website.

I looking mainly for European market that is willing to self host your content or the model on your own servers, we will provide the technical support in doing so that and easily plugin the AI powered search or chatbot to the website.
